name: Hourtick API
description:
The Hourtick REST API. Authenticate with a personal API token: create one in **Settings → API tokens**, then send `Authorization: Bearer ht_…`.

All timer changes go through **POST /api/v1/commands**, the same endpoint the web and Mac apps use. Commands are idempotent per `commandId` (use a new UUID per action, reuse it to retry safely).

Every response carries a `Server-Time` header (epoch ms). Errors use RFC 9457 problem details.
